USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
Michael Meyer
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0103 | michael.meyer@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Inventory analyst at a third-party logistics provider, supporting warehouse accounts for a lawn and garden brand and a home decor distributor. Started on the warehouse floor in inventory control and moved into analysis work in 2020. Writes SQL Server queries and builds Excel reports that account managers use to track on-hand balances, slow movers and vendor receiving problems.

EXPERIENCE
Inventory Analyst | Corvane Fulfillment Services, Columbus, OH | Mar 2020 to Present
• Produce weekly inventory health reports for two client accounts, covering on-hand units, aged stock and open purchase orders for about 41,000 active SKUs.
• Write SQL Server queries to join receiving, purchase order and ASN data, and maintain an Excel vendor fill-rate summary that account managers bring to quarterly vendor reviews.
• Built an Excel slow-mover list that pairs aging with damage records, which the client uses to choose items to return or liquidate each quarter.
• Reconcile daily WMS on-hand balances against client ERP records and trace variances to receiving, picking or system timing.
• Update two Power BI pages built by the site reporting lead, mostly adding fields and fixing broken visuals after source changes.
• Built a weekly list of SKUs with no movement in 90 days, sorted by storage cost, so account managers can raise markdown or return options with each client early.
• Answer ad hoc questions from client buyers about order history and inbound timing, usually by pulling a query result into Excel the same day.
• Flagged a recurring unit of measure mismatch on inbound ASNs from one home decor vendor and worked with receiving to set up a manual check until the vendor corrected the feed.
• Prepare inventory slides for the monthly operations review with client directors.

Inventory Control Associate | Corvane Fulfillment Services, Columbus, OH | Jul 2016 to Feb 2020
• Ran daily cycle counts and recorded variances for six client accounts.
• Maintained item master and unit of measure data for more than 25,000 SKUs, correcting case pack and dimension errors that caused slotting problems.
• Helped set up count zones and labeling when one client moved its overflow stock into a second building in 2018, keeping location records accurate through the move.
• Learned basic SQL from the site reporting lead to pull cycle count history instead of waiting on weekly extracts.
• Kept an Excel log of count variances by location, which helped supervisors decide where to recount first.
• Trained new associates on count procedures and scanner use during the busy fall season.
• Supported peak season planning each fall with volume projections in Excel.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2016

SKILLS
Data and querying: SQL Server, joins, CTEs, Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP)
Reporting: Excel dashboards, Power BI (editing existing reports)
Supply chain systems: Blue Yonder WMS, SAP ERP extracts, EDI 856 and ASN data
Inventory: cycle counting, aging and slow-mover analysis, vendor fill rate, item master maintenance

ADDITIONAL
• APICS Certified in Planning and Inventory Management (CPIM), 2023
• Volunteer inventory lead for a Columbus school supply drive, tracking donations and distribution counts each August
